test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) ME - JB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd9d5e0b3475b3c80ac7c37e14f299c6de531c965149517585f31c5b3328cd2b.png] 

Option 2) UM - GZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cb87570cba08035653d44a1098edace453496f20c9849f8ee3e1b9d088ea80b.png] 

Option 3) SK - PH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb8e453dc0b860cf89c3447e1d2cc4109087af00027d7890787732b8e081107a.png] 

Option 4) FX - CU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3aff4a94497e76e5f7d41fd3802d84b6a10790b137576995a2aea2de8e1b9ee.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'UM - GZ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
